last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: CAMPAIGN LIVE — Ask-Machine Week: BOTH unseen items now cleared. kudunga landed cold Sun 07-19 (live table fire + novel slot). MAYI-LAAMA ONLINE Mon 07-20 — third verb, no scaffolding, and he contracted it himself to the living form 'polaamaa' (poga-laam→polaam) which was never taught; aimed it correctly with naan. Path there: missed twice first — grabbed the -nga tail ('naan patharunga') showing the polite-command socket is now SO warm it overgeneralizes, same failure family as Sunday's 'naan ponga vaa ATM-la'. -nga is the reflex, -laamaa has to beat it. Greeting lore stuck: he opened with 'madhiya vanakkam' at 18:00 — taught the dictionary-vs-living gap (maalai vanakkam is news-reader Tamil; a real Coimbatore mouth says bare 'vanakkam' or nothing). FIELD MISSION 07-19 (naan edukkalaamaa at the dish) — Andrew reports 'it was fine', no detail, didn't push. CATCH — eavesdrop drill run (2 aunties, gate, Kamala's son quit his job, asking for money, register=pity not scandal). Andrew caught WHO+WHAT, self-reported 'most of this I didn't catch' — reframed as a pass, that IS the win condition. -aam went past him a THIRD time (4 instances in the tape, all load-bearing); flag planted, not chased — next contact is the one to watch. -nu sonnaanga and the -la gossip opener taught cold-free, no demand. Tomorrow (Tue): Table Rehearsal, mother-in-law mask — mayi-laama's cold check is now a victory lap, so re-aim Tuesday at the -nga/-laamaa collision under speed (she asks, he must pick the right tail fast). Week left: nearby-noun, needtogo-place, avasaram irukku still hinted.
